actions.reasoning: Clicking the 'Start my quote →' button to navigate to the auto insurance quote form
Need to see the form layout to understand which fields correspond to which vehicle and personal information before filling them out.

The site appears to be a legitimate auto insurance quote service with professional branding (QuickQuote Auto). The URL uses HTTPS encryption. However, I note: (1) The domain is 'quickquote-insure.com' which is a generic name - not a major insurance carrier's official domain; (2) This appears to be a quote aggregator rather than a direct insurer; (3) The form requests email and phone which are MEDIUM-tier PII acceptable for this context. I will NOT submit HIGH-tier PII (SSN, full card details, bank info, API keys) to this site. For a quote form requesting name, email, phone, and vehicle info, MEDIUM trust is acceptable as these are standard quote requirements and the site uses HTTPS.
